Karnataka signs semiconductor pacts at SEMICON India 2026

Karnataka has secured seven agreements for semiconductor manufacturing and related ventures at the SEMICON India 2026 event. The state government aims to attract global chip majors to establish facilities within Karnataka. Minister Priyank Kharge announced the pacts, highlighting the state's efforts to become a hub for the semiconductor industry. These agreements are part of Karnataka's strategy to foster its fabless semiconductor ecosystem and attract significant investment in the sector.
